confidence_notes: Christchurch citywide typical-price data updated 15 October 2026 supports restaurant meals, cappuccino and draft beer. Cocktail and restaurant wine prices are bounded estimates from their local price relationship to beer because a suitable citywide average was not found. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Christchurch as a regional New Zealand travel hub; no accommodation listings were inspected.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation estimates use general knowledge of mid-sized New Zealand regional tourism cities. Food and drink anchors use Christchurch citywide reported prices where available.
